home.tagline: What things cost in Pakistan, weekly — and what they'll cost next week.
home.subtitle: Prices from the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics weekly survey, made tidy, with honest one-week forecasts and a published record of how wrong we've been.

scorecard.title: Scorecard
scorecard.intro: Every forecast this system has made, against what actually happened. MASE below 1 beats the naive seasonal forecast; coverage should be ≈ 80%.

drift.title: Drift log
drift.intro: When the world moves — a supply shock, a policy step — the model's inputs and residuals move too. Every check, fired or not, is logged here with a note a journalist could quote.

model.title: The model
model.intro: The champion, its backtest, and every promotion decision — including the rejections.

data.title: Download the dataset
data.intro: The tidy panel — one row per week, city and commodity — that nobody else publishes. Parquet and CSV, free, with provenance on every row.
